top_signals.title: US inflation again set to be a crucial factor for the midterms
top_signals.summary: Donald Trump was re-elected on the back of inflation anger, and his party is now in danger of losing control of the House and Senate for the same reason
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
